name: declaude
description: Rewrites Claude-English into plain English: sycophantic openers, hedging filler and padded phrasing out, facts, code blocks, names and numbers untouched. Runs an open-weights model on dedicated GPUs, so text never reaches a commercial AI provider.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Paste a dk_ key from speak-english.tenken.co/signin. Create an account there first. The plugin cannot rewrite anything without this key.

hook_enabled.title: Enable automatic rewrites
hook_enabled.description: Enter true or false. It is true by default. Set it to false to stop automatic rewrites. Each rewrite counts against your quota. Set it to false if you still run a manual declaude hook, because two hooks bill you twice.
